remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive. First modeled in clay in New York. O'Keeffe wrote: "All day I was at Mary Gallery's working on my sculpture" (O'Keeffe to Maria Chabot, 4 March 1946). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
